The mobile web interface is designed for small screens. It only provides a subset of the full web interface. 

* It always connects the E field. Can be switched off for airborne.
* It **ONLY** uses **H** sensors which are connected.
* Wait until selftest is finished and GPS is green.
* set the dipole length for N&rarr;S and E&rarr;W (no rotation)
* select the sampling rate *or* a JobList
* in case set a filter or a shot rate
* &rArr; off you go

![](_media/nuclear-sign-icon.svg){width="10%"} [<br>**mobile will sync its jobs to mcpdb and remove others**]{style="color:red;"}

[**The design is for error free simple operation**]{style="color:green;"}
